text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D24","page":1,"quote":"⌀8   H7 THRU`"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 hole (D24) is a tight ISO fit on a part that receives zinc plating, but the drawing does not state whether the H7 tolerance applies before or after plating. Plating buildup will reduce the bore and can cause the mating pin to no longer fit; the designer should add a note specifying the pre-plate size or instructing reaming after surface treatment.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as 'H7 TOLERANCE APPLIES AFTER PLATING' or specify an undersize pre-plate dimension for D24."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-\n1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 28-32 HRC.\n2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies the hardness range but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment is to be performed (e.g., before final machining, before plating). Without this sequence the supplier cannot guarantee dimensional stability of the tight-tolerance features after hardening; the designer should add the process stage.","recommended_correction":"Revise N1 to include the stage, e.g., 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-32 HRC BEFORE FINAL MACHINING AND SURFACE TREATMENT.'"}]}
